name.en: Aluminium frame family (anodized alloy), mounting, grounding and drainage features
name.es: Familia de marco de aluminio (aleado anodizado), fijacion, puesta a tierra y drenaje

description.en: Frame features used in the module datasheets: anodized aluminium alloy frame, 4 mm grounding holes, drainage holes, mounting holes M6 and M8, and clamp contact requirements from the JinkoSolar manual. Section dimensions, wall thickness, groove and alloy temper are not stated in any source reached.
description.es: Caracteristicas del marco en las fichas: marco de aleacion de aluminio anodizado, orificios de puesta a tierra de 4 mm, orificios de drenaje, orificios de fijacion M6 y M8 y requisitos de contacto de abrazadera segun el manual JinkoSolar. Ninguna fuente consultada indica dimensiones de seccion, espesor de pared, ranura ni temple de la aleacion.

typical_use: Frame of the G12 and M10 module formats; section data to be added from a manufacturer drawing.

parts.name: Frame section (height, width, wall, groove)
parts.material: anodized aluminium alloy; temper 6063-T5 not stated in sources; 15 micron anodizing printed (S22)
parts.geometry_hint: Section polygon not stated; 'double webbed' profile printed by Heliene (S22). Needed for 2D/3D.

parts.name: Grounding hole, bolted grounding only

ratings.note: cannot be used for module installation

parts.geometry_hint: Long side of back frame near the edge (S8). Diameter printed as 4.0 (S8, S21, S22) and 4.2 (S3, S24); both kept as printed. Renew prints 2 holes, Heliene 4 holes.

parts.name: Drainage holes (as printed)
parts.geometry_hint: 8-phi3*8 printed in S3 (AIKO); not stated in S8

parts.name: Mounting hole for M8 bolt
parts.geometry_hint: 4 inner holes (8-hole) or 4 outer holes (12-hole) per family (S8 Table 2). Printed size 14 x 9 (S8, S21); Trina prints 9 x 14 (S23). Positions not stated.

parts.name: Mounting hole for M6 bolt
parts.geometry_hint: Printed size 10 x 7 (S8, S21); Trina prints 7 x 10 (S23). Positions not stated.

parts.name: Corner keys
parts.geometry_hint: No source printed corner keys. LONGi clamp rules for corner clamping (length >= 60 mm, overlap >= 9 mm) are clamp data, not corner keys (S24).

geometry.description: No positioned elements: the section, hole positions and clamp reference edges need a manufacturer drawing before placement in 2D/3D. Clamp zone numbers are kept as printed with their source.

clamping_zones_mm.note: printed as A = (250-350) mm, p.23; reference edge for A not stated
printed as A = (360-430) mm, p.22; reference edge not stated
printed as A = (210-310) mm, pp.28-29; reference edge not stated
reference edge and L definition not stated in the extract
A not defined in the extract; not converted to a value

anodizing_thickness_um.note: printed as '15-Micron Anodized Aluminum Alloy' for Heliene HSPE 132HC G12R; not confirmed for other families

mechanical_ratings.clamp_zone_formula: JinkoSolar manual gives L = A/4 +-50 mm and similar, with A undefined in the text (S8). Not used as a value.

installation_load_pa_examples.note: from S8 Table 2 bolt mounting; test load = 1.5 x design load

mechanical_ratings.clamp_zone_formula_longi: 1/4 L - 50 <= D <= 1/4 L + 50 mm, L as printed; reference edge not stated (S24 p.14)

grounding_conductor.note: grounding screw penetrates the anodized coating; Trina recommends < 1 ohm (S23)

unverified_items: Section dimensions, wall thickness and groove size not stated in any source reached.
Alloy temper 6063-T5 not stated in any source; Trina gives 6005-T5/T6 for clamps only.
Anodizing thickness 15 micron printed by Heliene only; not confirmed for other families.
Grounding hole diameter 4.0 (S8, S21, S22) vs 4.2 (S3, S24): both kept as printed.
Mounting hole positions not stated; Trina prints M8 hole as 9 x 14 vs 14 x 9 elsewhere.
Clamp reference edge (A, B, D) not stated in Trina or LONGi extracts, so no clamp zone is positioned.
Drainage hole size and positions not stated (except 8 x phi3 x 8 printed by AIKO in S3).
